# **0\. Document Purpose**

এই document-এর উদ্দেশ্য হলো Creator Dashboard-এর existing useful structure নষ্ট না করে Phase 2 onboarding flow এবং Dashboard-এর My Idea workspace-কে একটি single connected system-এ implement করা।

Antigravity প্রথমে codebase audit করবে, তারপর approved source hierarchy অনুযায়ী implementation করবে। নতুন standalone HTML file বানানো যাবে না; existing application stack-এর ভিতরেই routes, components, state and persistence connect করতে হবে।

| FINAL OUTCOME Creator clicks New Idea or starts without an idea → enters an isolated Phase 2 experience → completes idea discovery/refinement, selection, naming and branding → data is saved → returns to Dashboard → My Idea shows the exact completed workspace structure defined in the Creator Dashboard HTML. |
| :---- |

# **1\. Non-Negotiable Rules**

**•** Do not create a Google Stitch prompt. This is an Antigravity execution document.

**•** Do not create a separate HTML prototype. Modify the real app using its current framework and conventions.

**•** Do not redesign the supplied screens. Match the supplied images and Figma Dev Mode measurements as closely as possible.

**•** Do not replace or damage the existing Creator Dashboard Overview.

**•** Replace the current/old My Idea implementation with the My Idea workspace structure from the supplied Creator Dashboard HTML.

**•** During active Phase 2 onboarding, remove the global sidebar, dashboard header, search bar, breadcrumbs, notification icons and footer. Show only the Phase 2 page canvas and one Back control at the top-left.

**•** All platform-visible text must be English only. No Bangla may appear in buttons, labels, AI questions, helper text, validation, errors, empty states, notifications or tooltips.

**•** Use the earlier Phase 2 HTML for interaction logic and flow, not for its dark visual theme.

**•** Use the supplied light visual references and Figma Dev Mode for the final visual design.

**•** Use real saved data. Do not hardcode AutoInvoice or completed scores as permanent production data.

**•** New Idea must create a new draft and must not overwrite an existing completed idea without explicit confirmation.

# **4\. Final UX Architecture**

## **4.1 Two different layouts — never mix them**

| Layout | Used for | Visible chrome |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Creator Dashboard Shell** | Dashboard, completed My Idea workspace, Project Studio, assets and future history. | Sidebar \+ dashboard header \+ content area. |
| **Phase 2 Isolated Shell** | New idea, discovery, refinement, selection, naming, branding and completion. | No sidebar, no dashboard header, no search, no breadcrumbs, no footer. Only a top-left Back control. |

| Visual rule “Same-to-same” applies to the content canvas of each supplied reference screen. The global header/footer shown in some images must be removed because the latest founder instruction explicitly requires an isolated page. |
| :---- |

## **4.2 Navigation entry points**

| 1 | Sidebar → My Idea Open the dashboard My Idea workspace. Its content changes by idea state: empty, in progress, or complete. |
| :---: | :---- |

| 2 | Dashboard → New Idea Create a new draft and open the isolated Phase 2 Smart Gate. |
| :---: | :---- |

| 3 | My Idea → Edit Concept Open the isolated flow at the Idea Summary / Refinement step for the active idea. |
| :---: | :---- |

| 4 | My Idea → Resume Open the exact saved Phase 2 step and restore all saved fields. |
| :---: | :---- |

| 5 | Phase 2 → Back Return to the previous Phase 2 step. From the first step, return to the dashboard without deleting the draft. |
| :---: | :---- |

## **4.3 My Idea state model**

| State | Dashboard My Idea content | Primary actions |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **No idea exists** | Clean empty state explaining Project Identity and the two start paths. | Start with my idea / Help me discover an idea. |
| **Draft in progress** | Draft name, selected path, current step, last saved time, completion percentage and compact snapshot. | Resume / Start over with confirmation. |
| **Phase 2 complete** | Exact full My Idea workspace from the Creator Dashboard HTML. | Edit Concept / Update Branding / Start New Idea. |

# **8\. State, Data and Persistence Contract**

## **8.1 Required entity shape**

| IdeaDraft {  id, creatorId, projectId,  pathType: "refinement" | "discovery",  status: "draft" | "synthesizing" | "selected" | "identity\_ready",  currentStep,  discoveryInputs: { sectors\[\], observedProblem, complements\[\] },  refinementMessages\[\],  generatedConcepts\[\],  selectedConceptId,  ideaSnapshot: {    concept, targetUser, coreProblem, solution, marketGap, founderEdge  },  analysis: {    clarityScore, confidence, feasibilityScore, marketSize,    competitorSaturation, scoreDimensions\[\]  },  projectIdentity: {    name, audience, valueProposition, oneLiner,    logoUrl, brandingMethod, palette\[\], typography,    brandingStatus  },  version, createdAt, updatedAt, completedAt} |
| :---- |

Antigravity must map this logical structure to the existing backend/domain model instead of forcing a new incompatible schema.

## **8.2 Save rules**

**•** Create a draft before leaving the Smart Gate.

**•** Auto-save form input with debounce and show a non-intrusive saved indicator.

**•** Persist AI conversation messages and extracted structured fields.

**•** Persist generated cards as a generation round so back navigation does not regenerate automatically.

**•** Persist selected card immediately.

**•** Use optimistic UI only when rollback/error handling exists.

**•** On completion, create an immutable Phase 2 snapshot/version and mark the active project identity ready.

**•** New Idea creates a new \`ideaId\`; it does not mutate a completed idea unless the user selected Edit.

## **8.3 API integration guidance**

First inspect the existing services and endpoint conventions. Reuse them where possible. The following are logical capabilities, not mandatory URL names:

**•** Create/read/update idea draft.

**•** Save discovery inputs and refinement messages.

**•** Start synthesis and poll/read job status.

**•** Read generated concepts and select one.

**•** Update structured idea snapshot.

**•** Generate project-name suggestions.

**•** Generate/regenerate logo concepts.

**•** Save branding selection or designer engagement status.

**•** Complete Phase 2 and propagate outputs.

# **11\. Figma Dev Mode Protocol**

Founder পরে Figma Dev Mode link দেবে। Link পাওয়ার পর Antigravity implementation-এর আগে component-level inspection করবে।

| Figma item to inspect | Required use |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Frame dimensions** | Match content max-width, card grid width and vertical spacing. |
| **Auto Layout** | Reproduce gaps, padding, alignment and responsive constraints. |
| **Text styles** | Map headings to Syne and body/UI to DM Sans unless Figma specifies a newer token. |
| **Color styles** | Use exact values and existing design tokens; do not approximate. |
| **Component variants** | Use correct default, hover, selected, disabled, loading and error states. |
| **Icons** | Use the designated icon library and exact size/stroke. |
| **Exportable assets** | Export logo/illustration assets at correct format and scale. |

| Figma link placeholder Figma Dev Mode URL: \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ |
| :---- |

**•** Antigravity must report any conflict between Figma and this document before changing product behavior.

**•** Figma controls visual measurements. This document controls flow, state, routing, language and integration.

## **Stage C — Verification deliverables**

**•** Before/after route map.

**•** List of changed files and why each file changed.

**•** Desktop screenshots for every Phase 2 screen and all three My Idea states.

**•** Functional test results for both Phase 2 branches.

**•** Persistence test: refresh, back, logout/login and resume.

**•** Regression confirmation that Dashboard Overview, Messenger, Notifications and other sidebar pages still work.

**•** Accessibility checks for keyboard focus, labels, contrast, error messaging and reduced motion.

# **13\. Acceptance Criteria**

| Acceptance item | Pass condition |
| :---- | :---- |
| **My Idea replacement** | Sidebar My Idea opens the new dashboard workspace, never the old model. |
| **New Idea routing** | New Idea opens isolated Smart Gate and creates a new draft. |
| **No shell leakage** | No sidebar/header/search/breadcrumb/footer appears during active Phase 2\. |
| **Back behavior** | Top-left Back works at every step and preserves draft data. |
| **Both branches complete** | Clear idea and discovery paths both reach Project Identity Ready. |
| **Missing screens delivered** | Naming, branding, designer path, AI logo and completion are functional. |
| **Dynamic content** | No production view depends on hardcoded AutoInvoice data. |
| **English-only UI** | No Bangla or mixed-language platform text remains. |
| **Visual match** | Desktop layout closely matches uploaded references and Figma Dev Mode. |
| **Data propagation** | Completion updates Dashboard, My Idea, Project Studio and Asset Library. |
| **No regression** | Existing dashboard pages and navigation continue to work. |

## **13.1 Functional test matrix**

| Test | Expected result |
| :---- | :---- |
| **New user → My Idea** | Empty state appears inside dashboard shell. |
| **Empty state → Refine My Idea** | Draft created; isolated Smart Gate/refinement opens. |
| **Empty state → Discover** | Draft created; isolated discovery opens. |
| **Refresh mid-flow** | Same idea and step restore. |
| **Back from first step** | Returns to dashboard; draft remains. |
| **Generate ideas** | Progress resolves to unique cards or shows recoverable error. |
| **Select and change idea** | Selection persists; change returns without regeneration. |
| **Name and brand** | Project preview updates; selections persist. |
| **AI logo regenerate** | New generation round appears without deleting previous selection until confirmed. |
| **Complete Phase 2** | Identity ready snapshot saved and My Idea complete state appears. |
| **Start New Idea after completion** | New draft is separate; completed idea remains intact. |
| **Edit completed idea** | Isolated edit flow opens and all connected views update after save. |

# **14\. Explicit “Do Not” List**

**✕** Do not build another full dashboard for Phase 2\.

**✕** Do not keep the old My Idea screen hidden behind a second route.

**✕** Do not put the isolated flow inside an iframe or modal.

**✕** Do not use the old dark Phase 2 theme.

**✕** Do not copy the screenshots as one flat background image.

**✕** Do not invent new platform copy in Bangla.

**✕** Do not regenerate ideas every time the user returns to the cards page.

**✕** Do not overwrite a completed project when New Idea is clicked.

**✕** Do not duplicate Hire Providers, Messenger or Asset Library functionality.

**✕** Do not show fake “analysis complete” results before the data exists.

**✕** Do not delete useful existing components until their replacement is verified.

**✕** Do not change Dashboard Overview layout beyond the required action/data wiring.
